📋 Test Rules

Read these rules carefully before starting. The timer begins the moment you press Start.

  • ⏱ You have %MINS% minutes. Once it starts, the timer cannot be paused.
  • 🚫 Copy and paste is disabled. All answers must be typed or selected by hand.
  • 🚫 Do not switch tabs, open other windows, or use other applications. Every tab switch is logged and sent to your teacher.
  • 🚫 Do not use AI, dictionaries, or translation engines during the test.
  • 📝 The test has three sections, shown one at a time: A — choose the word for each meaning from a list (%A%); B — type the word for each meaning (%B%); C — write your own sentence for %C% more words.
  • ➡️ Next is one-way. When you leave a section you cannot go back to it, so check your answers before you continue.
  • ✍️ Sections A and B are marked automatically and give you your score. Section C is marked by your teacher — the page only checks that your sentence really uses the word and is a full sentence.
  • ⏳ The Submit button unlocks after 2 minutes.
  • 🔒 Your session is monitored. Tab switches, paste attempts and typing patterns are sent with your answers.
  • 🖥 Entering full screen is strongly recommended.
⚠️ Academic integrity: Using outside help, AI, or another person's answers may result in a failing grade. By clicking Start you confirm this is your own independent work.
